correctness.rationale: The RESULT.md renewal equation has transform H_x(s)/(1-rH_nu(s)); exponential tilting gives a positive finite-mean renewal kernel and a genuine e^{-lambda t} tail, not just a Laplace pole. The strictly increasing parametrization r=D theta^2/(1-q_L(theta)) and objective lambda=D theta^2 q/(1-q), q=p exp(-theta)+(1-p)exp(-L theta), are correct for p=c/L^2. The two nondegenerate charts theta=u/L and theta=v have unique maxima u=1.593624260040... and v=2; a uniform intermediate-scale bound excludes third competing global maxima. Height crossing gives c*=e^2 C/4, C=u^2/(exp(u)-1), and c_L=c*+K/L^2+O(L^-3) with K=(e^2/4)c*(2u)-c*^2/e^2. The finite-L coexistence uniqueness is local near c*. Bounded independent numerical branch optimizations at L=60 and 240 confirm both competing scalings, not an infinity proof.
